column3: Kuroneko Route · The Discussion with Dad
Kyousuke.
Huh?
Have you... gotten yourself a girlfriend?
Huh?!
W-What does he think he's asking?!
I've heard from your mother. You have been bringing your girlfriend home recently.
Is he talking about Kuroneko...!?
N-No, that's, uh... I'm just helping her with making a game...
My Mom's so loose-lipped... And moreover, her misunderstanding led to her telling Dad...
I've also heard she hasn't been here lately.
Urk...
Have you two quarreled?
You... could say that.
Although this misunderstanding isn't really great, it doesn't seem bad discussing this with Dad.
I don't have the slightest idea what she's thinking, so I'm in a bit of a pinch.
I see
You're like me, socially awkward.
Seems like it.
*cough*... To cross paths with one another is something that can happen to anyone.
Also, this will easily become the cause for clashes and quarrels.
Although I haven't seen you and Mom quarrel before...
That's just because we don't let you see.
I'm like what you said earlier. Even now, there are times when I don't understand what your mother is going on about.
Not knowing what the other is angry about. Not knowing what the other is unhappy about. Not knowing what the other is... thinking about.
The more you're concerned about the other party, all the more easier for your actions and words to hurt them.
In situations like that... what should I do?
It's hard to say, there isn't a standard answer for that. All you can do is to think about it seriously, and take the action you think is the best.
Kyousuke, don't think about "being successful". It's impossible for us.
Impossible?
Yes. However, even you have your own way of doing things, so allow me to take a look at it sometime.
...I don't want to have this situation twice.
Even the useless can do something if they put effort in it.
I get it, I'll give it a try, Dad.
I see.
If you two were to reconcile, introduce her to us. I'm looking forward to it.
Like I said that's just a misunderstanding...
